name: Photo Eye

maxRange.label: Max range (m)
maxRange.desc: How far down the beam a target still counts as present. The beam is cast along local +Z, so aim the sensor by rotating it; snapping it onto a conveyor guard fits this range across the lane for you.

mode.label: Sensing mode
mode.desc: How the eye is installed. Diffuse: the target itself reflects the light back to the eye, so nothing stands opposite it. Retro-reflective: the eye looks at a reflector on the far side of the lane and a target breaking that beam is detected; the reflector is drawn at Max range, so snapping the eye onto a conveyor guard puts it on the far guard. In the sim both detect the same way: a target in the beam before Max range.

showBeam.label: Show beam
showBeam.desc: Draw the beam line in the viewport. A viewing aid only - hiding it does not change what the sensor detects.

normallyClosed.label: Normally closed (inverts the signal)
normallyClosed.desc: Invert the output, so the tag reads true when NOTHING is detected. The beam colour still follows the real detection, not the inverted signal.

mark.label: Only marked targets
mark.desc: Count a target only if a machine upstream left this mark on it (wrapped, or a label a labeller wrote). Empty: anything in the beam counts. This is how a program checks a product, not just its presence - a load that was never wrapped reads as clear.

enableComms.label: Enable comms
enableComms.desc: Connect this part to a PLC program. Its tags appear once this is on.

tag.label: Presence tag
tag.desc: Where the photoeye publishes presence for the program to read. Whether true means blocked or clear is set by Normally closed above.
